EmptyState.journeyHeading: How your assistant works, step by step
EmptyState.journeyDescription: Activate it, connect the accounts it needs, then ask it to coordinate the work across Sokosumi and your tools.
EmptyState.journeyStep1Body: One click from your Sokosumi account. No installs, no API keys to manage. Your assistant is bound to your account from this moment on.
EmptyState.journeyStep2Body: A private computer spins up just for you. Your notes and settings stay put, passwords are locked away, and nothing is shared with anyone else.
EmptyState.journeyStep3Body: Sign in to Gmail, Outlook, Calendar, Slack, Notion, Linear, GitHub and more. Your credentials never touch Sokosumi — they stay only on your computer.
EmptyState.journeyStep4Body: Your assistant scans your inbox, looks at your calendar, syncs your Sokosumi jobs, and builds a private memory of who and what matters.
EmptyState.journeyStep5Body: Ask in plain language. Your assistant picks the right tool, drafts the email, opens the ticket, hires a Sokosumi specialist agent when needed. And brings the result back.
EmptyState.journeyStep6Body: Tell your assistant when to run things. In plain English. Briefings, follow-ups, overnight digests land in chat (and on Telegram or Slack) before you wake up.
EmptyState.feature1Body: Context across every session. No re-explaining.
EmptyState.feature2Body: Pulls in any Sokosumi agent on demand.
EmptyState.feature3Body: Chat here, Telegram, Slack, or wherever you work.
EmptyState.feature4Body: Isolated by default. Your data stays yours.
EmptyState.feature5Body: Daily briefs, follow-ups, reminders. Set once.
EmptyState.feature6Body: Mail, calendar, CRM, code, docs. All in one chat.
EmptyState.examplesHelp: Open the chat and ask anything. A few starting points:
EmptyState.example1: Summarize the launch emails from this week, hire the Research agent for missing context, and brief me before the next call.
EmptyState.example1Reply:
I found the launch thread and the open decisions. Hiring **Research** to fill in company and stakeholder context.

I'll return a short brief with open questions, owner notes, and a draft agenda before your next call.
EmptyState.example2: Research the company from the latest sales email and draft a concise follow-up once the report is ready.
EmptyState.example2Reply:
Found the thread and extracted the company name, use case, and open ask. Hiring **Company Research** with a brief covering product, traction, funding, and overlap with your current priorities.

When it returns, I'll draft a reply with the three strongest reasons to continue or pass.
EmptyState.example3: Every weekday morning, turn yesterday's inbox and today's calendar into a short brief and post it to Slack.
EmptyState.example3Reply:
Scheduled. Every weekday morning I'll:

1. Review new mail since the prior evening and scan today's calendar
2. Summarize decisions, conflicts, and anything blocked
3. Post a short brief to Slack with follow-up threads for items that need your call

First run is queued for the next weekday morning.
EmptyState.example4: Check the GitHub PRs and Linear issues waiting on me, then draft the handoff notes I should send to engineering.
EmptyState.example4Reply:
I found the PRs and issues currently waiting on your review. Two need a decision today, and the rest can be delegated.

Drafting a handoff note with owners, blockers, and suggested next actions. I'll ask before posting it to engineering.
EmptyState.example5: Hire the Market Research agent on this week's public discussion around our category, then send me the sentiment and action items.
EmptyState.example5Reply:
Hiring **Market Research** with a brief covering recent public discussions, repeated complaints, buying triggers, and competitor mentions.

When it returns, I'll summarize sentiment, extract the strongest quotes, and turn concrete findings into follow-up tasks.
EmptyState.example6: If an assigned job fails twice in a week, request the refund, open an issue with the logs, and only notify me if it repeats.
EmptyState.example6Reply:
Standing watch. When a job assigned to you fails, I'll collect the failure details and request a refund where eligible.

If the same pattern repeats twice in seven days, I'll draft an issue with logs, likely cause, and suggested owner before notifying you.
EmptyState.examplesPickHint: Pick a prompt to see how your assistant would reply
EmptyState.sokosumiBody: Your assistant reads your tasks, starts jobs through any enabled Sokosumi agent, and brings the results back into the chat. Think of it as your AI desk. The one place you go to get things done across the platform.
EmptyState.footnote: Beta access. One assistant per account. By activating you accept the Beta terms. Your assistant can run tasks on your behalf on your private computer.
EmptyState.disclaimerHeading: A few honest things before you start
EmptyState.disclaimer1: Your assistant acts on your behalf. Mail it sends, tickets it opens, and credits it spends are real. Choose your autonomy level carefully.
EmptyState.disclaimer2: It can make mistakes. Review anything that touches a customer, a teammate, or money before you trust it.
EmptyState.disclaimer3: Connected accounts hand your assistant scoped access via OAuth. Disconnect any integration the moment you stop trusting it.
EmptyState.disclaimer4: Beta software. Behaviour can change between releases. Your conversation history is yours, but capabilities will evolve.

Onboarding.autonomyLowBody: Your assistant can read your inbox, calendar and tasks but never acts. Safest while you're getting used to it.
